exempt.dhcp_phone_profile_scope: link row: the phone profile keeps existing, only its scope binding goes
exempt.dns_acl_entry: the entries of an ACL; they are the ACL, not a separate object
exempt.dns_agent_bundle: the cached config bundle built for an agent, regenerated from the database
exempt.dns_blocklist_group_assoc: link row between a blocklist and a group; the blocklist keeps existing
exempt.dns_blocklist_view_assoc: link row between a blocklist and a view; the blocklist keeps existing
exempt.dns_pool_member: the members of a pool; they are the pool, not a separate object
exempt.dns_record_op: queued record operations for agents; transient
exempt.dns_server: the group delete is refused while it holds servers, so it never cascades
exempt.dns_server_runtime_state: per-server runtime status reported by an agent, not operator-entered
exempt.dns_server_zone_state: per-server zone sync status reported by an agent, not operator-entered
exempt.dns_trust_anchor: validation trust anchors held on the group's views; part of the view's configuration
exempt.erl_binding: the delete is refused while an E911 location binding names the row, so it never cascades
exempt.ip_mac_history: the address's own MAC history; it is the address, not a separate object
exempt.subnet_domain: link row between a subnet and a DNS zone; the zone keeps existing
exempt.subnet_utilization_history: derived daily utilization snapshots, not operator-entered

extra: the DNS records published for its addresses
